aggregation_policy: finalizer requires 15 new train/evaluate runs, 5 direct references, and five baseline artifacts; it only aggregates existing artifacts
causality_contract: T_i is used only to construct phase/progress supervision and valid masks; no model condition receives final duration
checkpoint_selection: min validation joint objective loss; tie lower progress MAE; tie higher phase BA
direct_reuse: Exp5.3.2.2 rsnn_h64 checkpoints/evaluations/histories are reused by identity-validated references and are never retrained
linear_control_role: linear64_rsnn64 has the same trainable weight shapes and paired initial weights as ffsnn64_rsnn64; the LIF transform is the only difference
primary_metrics: paired per-seed deltas against direct RSNN64
run_order: condition-major: tasks 0-4 linear64_rsnn64, 5-9 ffsnn64_rsnn64, 10-14 ffsnn128_rsnn64; direct_rsnn64 is identity-validated reuse
scientific_question: whether a pre-recurrent feedforward SNN transform improves the supervised causal WHEN representation relative to direct RSNN64
winner_rule: prefer strict Pareto improvement over direct on mean phase BA and mean progress MAE; then use history gains, generalization gap, spike accessibility, and parameter cost as diagnostics
